summary: Configured a 512 MiB LUKS2-encrypted XFS volume on node1, mounted at /srv/secure. It automatically unlocked and mounted after a verified node reboot, with persisted data intact.
actions_performed: Created a root-owned encrypted container and node-generated key file.
Configured automatic unlock in /etc/crypttab and automatic mounting in /etc/fstab.
Verified the systemd unlock path before reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified recovery.

evidence.summary: Confirms a valid LUKS2 volume, active AES-XTS encrypted mapping, XFS mount at /srv/secure, and readable persistence marker.

evidence.requirement: Automatic unlock and mount at boot
evidence.summary: Shows crypttab/fstab configuration, successful systemd-managed unlock test, and automatic post-boot recovery.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and persistence verification
evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID 0305efed-2c0e-4265-b609-10e8259d59a7, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 65edd586-2fbe-4785-a60f-e93f3ab4738a, active encrypted mapping, mounted filesystem, intact data, and no failed units.
